author: 1337isnot1337, with substantial Kimi AI assistance
statement: Balanced real-port packing requires maximum degree at most 3M/r, and unsplit aggregate vertices preserve this obstruction through recursion. In the stated one-monomial aggregate model, wires o(n log log n) imply a persistent-degree/direct-leaf obstruction asymptotically larger than the accepted leaf exponent; keeping that scale retains Theta(n log log n) wires. This is representation-specific and establishes no new SAT bound.
remaining_obligations: Independent review of the written all-size argument
Any improvement requires a new tensor decomposition, unbalanced recursion, or faster leaf method
